Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates a visible visceral pleural line with absent lung markings peripherally in the right hemithorax, confirming a pneumothorax which explains the acute shortness of breath and chest discomfort. This finding is mechanistically linked to the underlying bullous lung disease (emphysematous changes) seen in the image, as ruptured bullae are a common cause of spontaneous pneumothorax.
